mappings.meaning: Camera activation bounds in the exact shared camera-check format.
Final camera-bound WORDs for the shared boss transition.
Run the shared staged camera locking and delayed boss-music transition.
Install the active battle dispatcher after shared camera setup completes.
Shared RTS used by battle setup and several cross-file child tails.
Run battle state, consume a returned-capsule hit latch, periodically sound and collision-draw.
Shared draw/touch tail after active state and hit handling.
Six relative WORD entries with shared movement states for release and closure phases.
Initialize the eight-hit boss and one or two independently allocated player-targeted bumpers.
Return from initialized descent after optional bumper creation.
Integrate boss descent before the signed wait callback.
Set up vertical swing and one-pixel-per-update horizontal patrol velocity.
Select patrol wait and clear the coordinated release/opening flags.
Run patrol movement and wait for the next coordinated capsule callback.
Start another coordinated capsule opening only while the active-count BYTE is below three.
Reload a short wait when three capsules are already counted active.
Patrol while the fixed-delay opening or closing raw script selects its callback.
Set the parent release signal after the opening animation completes.
Select closure raw animation and install the reusable patrol-wait callback.
Leave the scored defeat wait and prepare a gravity-driven fall.
Apply light gravity until the defeated boss reaches the scene-effect threshold.
Install the scene handshake wait and attempt three independent effect groups.
Wait for the right explosion emitter to reach its boundary before releasing scene actors.
Return during the emitter handshake or after scene-release setup.
Use exact countdown values to signal the foreground and unlock the route.
Clear boss mode, restore DEZ2 music and attempt gradual route expansion.
Return between exact countdown events or after maximum-X actor allocation.
Track the camera minimum until the exit threshold, then extend the maximum once.
Return before or immediately after selecting the player-exit gate.
Wait until Player1 reaches 0x160 pixels ahead of camera X.
Save act-three carryover fields and start encoded level 0x1700.
Initialize a player-targeted bumper with inherited boss mappings and art.
Choose Player1 for subtype zero or Player2 for any nonzero subtype.
Compute bumper bearing and move near-zero bearings to an opening-sector boundary.
Store the bearing, position from the parent lookup curve and apply bumper contact.
Initialize the normal capsule child before parent release.
Keep the capsule attached until parent +0x38 bit 2 requests release.
Install the capsule extension phase with a countdown consumed immediately.
Advance capsule release extension until the signed timer underflows.
Follow and draw the capsule after the alternating extension step.
Start a short parent-X-following gravity interval after extension.
Keep parent X alignment during the short release interval and play bounce at its end.
Align capsule integer X with the parent before the current gravity step.
Move the newly released capsule and select ceiling or floor distance by current vertical speed.
Correct a downward/nonnegative-velocity capsule only on negative floor penetration.
Check the initial-flight capsule own status and optionally flicker-draw it.
Install the landed capsule state dispatcher with a ten-second lifetime and random horizontal drift.
Store randomly selected initial capsule drift and end vertical landing motion.
Attempt one explosion before installing a callback-selected capsule destruction wait.
Count this capsule as removed and wait eight updates before the chosen destruction callback.
Attempt three normal debris children after the explosion wait and schedule capsule deletion.
Run the five-state capsule graph, then parent death, boss-range damage and collision drawing.
Five relative WORD state offsets for resting, rolling, dropping, launched and expiry phases.
Process a resting capsule player contact, possible gravity-side drop and lifetime countdown.
Move a rolling capsule and maintain its contact, bounds and lifetime behavior.
Start the capsule expiry wait after its shared lifetime underflows.
Integrate reversible-gravity motion for the dropped capsule state.
Apply falling-contact suppression/attack handling and process upward ceiling penetration.
Select the resting capsule state after a landing/orientation combination.
Correct downward floor penetration and choose the orientation-dependent landed state.
Resume rolling after a landing aligned to the capsule orientation.
Return after absent penetration or completed rolling landing.
Advance the launched capsule WORD orientation countdown without reloading it.
Integrate launched motion and prepare its eventual +/-0x80 rolling speed.
Save the launch-derived horizontal landing speed before contact/landing handling.
Destroy an expired capsule and skip the remaining landed dispatcher wrapper.
Return with the original or deliberately shortened stack after the expiry gate.
Initialize one of three normal capsule fragments and replace its immediate capsule parent with the boss.
Move a fragment and draw/register contact only while its reassigned boss parent survives.
Immediately delete the fragment after its boss parent status bit7 is observed.
Initialize the animated sleeve attachment and attempt its position-copying overlay.
Animate the sleeve at its attached offset until the root release signal.
Select the sleeve extension phase and consume its first timer decrement immediately.
Extend the sleeve offset on every other nonnegative countdown update.
Update sleeve position and animation after the optional extension step.
Install a short sleeve hold timer after extension.
Hold the extended sleeve for the signed timer interval.
Install sleeve retraction and enter it on the same call.
Reduce sleeve BYTE offset every other call while checking the opening-state handshake.
Follow/animate the retracting sleeve, then touch-draw only while root opening flag remains set.
Schedule sleeve deletion when the root opening-state flag clears.
Initialize the sleeve overlay while retaining inherited resources and parent.
Copy the sleeve integer position exactly and honor its lifetime.
Initialize the Robotnik scene actor using the shared FBZ reaction updater.
Adjust the escaping Robotnik X only when Player1 is close behind.
Run the shared Robotnik running animation and existing escape velocity.
Initialize the scene piece that changes when the defeated boss releases scene actors.
Change the scene piece once parent aftermath bit4 is set.
Draw the scene piece after waiting or changing its release frame.
Initialize one of six subtype-indexed defeat debris pieces.
Initialize one of two independent defeat explosion emitters with integer-step motion.
Store the prepared signed integer X step and staggered explosion interval.
Attempt periodic random-offset explosions before each horizontal integer step.
Advance integer X using the stored signed step and select the horizontal boundary.
End the left-moving emitter horizontal sweep at or below X0x3450.
Clamp horizontal endpoint, switch to upward motion and signal only the subtype-zero emitter.
Return after the left boundary test or completed upward-transition setup.
Continue periodic explosion attempts during upward integer-step motion.
Move the emitter two integer Y pixels upward and delete below unsigned Y0x240.
Integrate capsule Y using the velocity after reversible gravity acceleration.
Enter falling routine when resting side mismatches active gravity.
Clear capsule vertical speed when gravity starts a new fall.
Return from capsule gravity/resting-side transition.
Handle consumed player contact while the player animation equals2.
Launch a capsule after grounded rolling-animation player contact.
Store launch direction and derive vertical launch magnitude from player ground speed.
Use at least500 hex of vertical launch magnitude.
Choose vertical launch direction from the capsule render flip-Y bit.
Store vertical launch velocity and exit the current resting state early.
Return after a resting capsule contact gate or launch-specific stack adjustment.
Apply ordinary hurt policy to non-grounded-rolling player contact.
Determine whether grounded rolling player velocity points toward the capsule.
Reverse selected player horizontal and ground speeds only for an approaching side.
Return from rolling capsule player-contact policy.
Select attack geometry only for player animation2 or9.
Hurt a contacting player unless its original two protection fields are set.
Check animation2/9 contact alignment against capsule orientation.
Reverse all selected player speeds and destroy the capsule on the accepted side.
Return from falling-contact policy or its accepted-attack stack continuation.
Reverse a negative-X-moving actor at or left of3488 hex.
Reverse horizontal velocity after the direction-specific inclusive bound test.
Return after horizontal boundary policy.
Return from bumper launch policy after optional consumed-player response.
Advance bumper frame while the reduced angle reaches each threshold.
Store the scanned bumper frame and choose render XY flip from original angle bit7.
Commit render flags after frame/flip selection.
Two padded seven-threshold lists for heading-based bumper mapping frame selection.
Return after selecting a capsule fragment frame and initial velocity.
Three WORD x/y velocity pairs for the capsule fragments.
Set boss returned-capsule hit latch only when flip and velocity signs agree.
Destroy every in-range capsule even if its vertical direction did not latch boss damage.
Return from parent hit-range policy or the consumed wrapper return.
Signed capsule-local square used to test the boss parent point.
Choose normal or alternate six-color row during a latched hit.
Advance latched flash and clear damage suppression at zero.
Return after the boss latch gate or flash update.
Begin defeat on health reaching zero and independently attempt two effect actors.
Apply common defeat timer/score after either gravity-reset allocation result.
Six scatter destination RAM addresses for returned-capsule hit flash.
Two disjoint six-WORD boss hit-flash color rows.
Persistent optional defeat effect that clears reverse gravity on every call.
Six-byte descriptor for each player-targeting boss bumper.
Six-byte descriptor for the animated parent-linked contact assembly.
Six-byte descriptor for the assembly origin-copy overlay.
Six-byte descriptor for the released/resting/rolling capsule.
Six-byte descriptor shared by the three moving capsule fragments.
Six-byte descriptor for six indexed defeat fragments.

Twelve-byte descriptor for the fixed exit panel actor.
Two normal-child records for the fixed exit Robotnik and panel actors.
Single repeated-entry child record for the player-targeting bumper.
Two distinct normal-child records emitted for a boss attack.
One simple child for the animated attack assembly overlay.
Three normal child fragment records created after capsule explosion wait.
Six repeated defeat-fragment children with externally selected frames and velocities.
Two repeated explosion-sweep controllers for the defeat scene.

Fixed-delay raw stream used after the capsule-release wait.
